name: Caramel Performance
source:
In this reality magic is not something cool or positive rather than body anomaly that faces constant condemned, censorship and criticism. It is difficult for the owner of magic to find work, housing, and acceptance in society. And main character is not exception.

Main character founds her salvation in the circus Kriv where each participant is a magic owner. As the story unfolds, you are absorbed in the circus, social and personal life of main character, as well as her troubles.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084090/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这个现实里，魔法不是件多酷的好事，而是一种身体上的异状，时时遭受谴责、审查与非议。有魔法的人很难找到工作、住所，也不容易被社会接纳。主人公亦不例外。

她在克里夫马戏团找到了自己的救赎，团里的每个人都拥有魔法。随着故事展开，你将走进她的马戏团生活、社交与私生活，也走进她的烦恼。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3084090/]Steam[/url]］
